aws.reason: The learning outcome is deterministic CI gate behavior, fully proven with a versioned local fixture; managed evaluation would add nondeterminism and resources without proving an additional acceptance criterion.
verified_claims: Amazon Bedrock supports automatic model evaluation jobs.
Managed evaluation requires model/Region support and an IAM service role; custom data uses Amazon S3.
Runtime inference quotas are per model and Region; this exercise invokes no model and consumes none.
Pricing is usage based and varies by selected model/evaluation path; this local exercise incurs no AWS charge.
